$comment: Mod sets the compat workflow runs the suite against, one game launch each.
extraMods is a comma separated list of owner/repo:AssetPrefix:packageId, staged from
GitHub releases by .github/scripts/stage-pickle-mods.sh. A Workshop-only mod cannot go
here: staging one needs Steam credentials the script deliberately does not take.
Every set costs a full suite run, so keep this list short.
